column1: # The planner routes the gateway forwarded from its hand-written list (PlannerProxyController.ROUTES
# and SecurityConfig's matchers), recorded from that code's behaviour on 2026-11-09 before both were
# replaced by the x-gateway extension in the planner's and the assistant's openapi.json.
# Captured by driving each route's sample path (every {var} as X) through the old controller against a
# fake upstream, and through the old SecurityConfig signed out, signed in as a pilot, and without a CSRF token.
# UpstreamRoutesTest and UpstreamSecurityRulesTest hold what the OpenAPI documents produce to it.
# The rows whose upstream is the assistant were taken out with it on 2026-11-12 (docs/decisions/0041).
